The '''Briefing Room''' was a room located in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] took control of the temple during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Briefing Room was used to brief [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] prior to missions. The Briefing Room was the location where [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Dodonna]] outlined the attack plan against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="ANH" />
